"He needs to be more self-critical. I want him to stay, and I genuinely believe he could do very well, but putting himself in this position because he wasn’t a starter, when he had chances and failed to take the, feels unfair for the club."

🚨 Karim Adeyemi completed a promising first 45 minutes for Barcelona against Birmingham City.

The German started on the right wing and showed his speed, verticality and constant movement despite limited space against an intense press.

He did not score or assist, but displayed personality on the ball and commitment defensively.

— @sport

Áron Yaakobishvili saved two penalties against Birmingham City, although Barcelona eventually lost the shootout.

The 20-year-old guessed the direction of almost every attempt and once again showed his special ability from the spot. His future remains open, with Racing Santander, Levante and Mallorca monitoring a possible loan.

— @sport

.@SantiNollaMD: "Hamza Abdelkarim gave Barcelona exactly what they are searching for in the market: a decisive number nine.

Barça may still pursue an established striker, but Hamza has earned the right to remain under Hansi Flick’s close watch."
